name: COLDFRAME BROADCAST NETWORK
description: Vantablack's dedicated news and current affairs neural network, operating under the Coldframe Corporate Media Solutions brand. Positions itself as the authoritative source for corponation policy updates, economic data feeds, and civic information across the megacity. Its editorial framework is structured around corponation-approved narrative guidelines, with a formal content review board staffed by Vantablack legal and Axiom communications liaisons.
cultural_impact: Became the default definition of 'official news' for most of Meridian 88's middle tiers, making its omissions and framings effectively invisible as editorial choices.
story_hooks: A Coldframe anchor approaches an underground journalist after her own network cuts her live feed during a sensitive testimony — she has a copy of what was omitted.
Someone begins filing formal content complaints against Coldframe using the network's own editorial standards document, and the complaints are technically irrefutable.
A researcher discovers that Coldframe's archive of the Lachine Corridor coverage has been retroactively edited — the original feeds still exist somewhere in a deprecated server cluster.
